name: CC-TH-70-25-UL Exothermic Mould (SEICO)
description_text:

The CC-TH-70-25-UL Exothermic Mould by SEICO is a premium-quality graphite exothermic welding mould designed to produce permanent, high-conductivity electrical connections for grounding and bonding systems. name: LOCTITE® 577 Pipe Thread Sealant – 50 ml | High Performance Anaerobic Thread Sealing Compound for Metal Pipe Fittings
description_text:
LOCTITE® 577 is a high-performance anaerobic pipe thread sealant designed for sealing and locking metal threaded pipe fittings and connections. It is a reliable industrial sealing solution that prevents leakage of gases, liquids, oils, hydraulic fluids, and process chemicals in threaded assemblies. The product cures in the absence of air between close-fitting metal surfaces, creating a strong, flexible seal that withstands vibration, pressure fluctuations, and temperature changes.

This Henkel LOCTITE® 577 thread sealant is specially developed for use on tapered and parallel metal pipe threads, providing excellent sealing performance without the need for PTFE tape, hemp, or traditional sealing materials. It fills the gaps between threaded components, preventing corrosion, loosening, and leakage while allowing easy assembly and future disassembly with standard hand tools.

Ideal for oil & gas, petrochemical, industrial, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and maintenance applications, LOCTITE® 577 provides dependable sealing for valves, pumps, compressors, pipe fittings, instrumentation connections, and industrial piping systems. It is suitable for use on common metal substrates including steel, stainless steel, brass, and other metal threaded fittings.

This 500g anti-seize compound helps reduce maintenance costs, minimizes equipment downtime, prevents thread damage, and extends the service life of critical components.
